reasoning: Most requested Administer mechanics are correct, but the ship construction wording makes a material timing claim. “After two successful Build actions” grammatically governs placing a partial ship when none exists, as well as the alternative completion. That delays the first stage until two successes and does not unambiguously describe the two successive stages. This is not a harmless compact equivalent of the rule. The summary labels the overall process “Two successful Build actions:” before its conditional instructions; the reader changes that label into a temporal prerequisite with “after”. Correct destination wording does not cure the erroneous first-stage timing.

fact_checks.finding: Uses the dice pool printed on the Governor office card.
Rolls the remaining pool without penalty and reduces it by one after every attempt, regardless of result.
£1 for success, £2 total if the immediately preceding roll was unsuccessful.
Selects exactly one of Build Company Ship, Commission Regiment, or Tax.

fact_checks.part: Ship first stage and regional destination
fact_checks.finding: The answer says “after two successful Build actions, place a partially built ship in the region if none is there”. The first successful Build action with no ship present immediately places the partially built ship in the Governor’s region; it does not require two successes.

fact_checks.part: Ship completion stage and sea destination
fact_checks.finding: The existing regional ship is correctly completed into the sea zone associated with the Governor’s President. However, the shared “after two successful Build actions” timing condition fails to state the correct per-success progression: first success places the partial ship; second success completes it. The destination and existing-ship condition are correct, while the stage timing is unresolved/erroneous.
Places the regiment in the Army associated with the Governor’s President.

fact_checks.part: Tax amount, split restriction and destinations
fact_checks.finding: Adds an unsplit £2 to either Company Balance or that President’s treasury.
Each Tax after the first this turn adds regional unrest.
Any unsuccessful roll adds one unrest in the region.
May repeat with the shrinking pool until voluntary stopping, no dice remaining, or catastrophe; catastrophe also vacates the office under the normal rule.

source_check.exact_text: Building a ship occurs over two successful actions. If there is no Company ship in your region, place one there. If there is already a Company ship in your region, move that ship to the sea zone associated with your President.
source_check.ruling: Each successful Build action resolves one conditional stage based on whether a ship is already in the region. One success places the partially built ship; another success moves it to the associated sea zone.
